**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Anchor the migration to an ancestor of this release**

For release SHA `7e78303ac3ea0c9ce025d7ea4edab5d03d81b8fa`, `441dfcc968559f829e84c89751f008657566138c` is not an ancestor (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` returns false). The guarded release path in `scripts/production-release.mjs` checks every `introducedBy` commit and explicitly refuses such a release, so planning or deploying this exact commit will fail before applying the migration. Record an introduction commit that is actually in this release's ancestry.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include discovery events in the pilot status count**

This function makes structured imports consume the same 20-item allowance as research candidates, but `loadPilotDTO` in `TDF.Server.EventResearch` still computes `erPilotActiveCandidates` solely from `event_research_candidate`. For example, with 19 candidates and one imported event, `GET /social-events/event-research/pilot` reports 19 of 20 while the next candidate is rejected by this trigger. Clients following the documented preflight therefore receive a misleading capacity value; derive the status count from the shared identities (or expose a separate shared count).

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
